title: change one thing, watch another follow a rule
seam: the changeable quantity: buttons data-action="dec" and data-action="inc" (one step each, never beyond min..max); its value shown in data-x="<x>"
the result: data-output with data-value="<y>" kept current, y = law.k * x + law.b, written as a number
the picture of the result: data-visual whose height (data-dim="h") or width (data-dim="w") is y * Studio.params.y.unitsPer px
brief: KIND: simulation. One quantity (xname) changes another (yname) by a rule: y = k * x + b (Studio.params.law).
SCENE: a picture of y that grows and shrinks smoothly (a bar, a tower, a fence ...) whose size is exactly y * unitsPer; the current x and y written as numbers with their names.
CONTROLS: two big buttons (strings less / more) change x by one step (Studio.params.x). Everything follows at once.

QUESTION: ask, about x = Studio.params.ask.x, with three option buttons (Studio.params.ask.options) -> Studio.answer({value: <option>}). Feedback from Studio.onVerdict; options stay tappable after wrong; on correct Studio.done().
antiPatterns: the picture scaled to fit instead of y * unitsPer
floating point noise in the shown numbers
